analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 52.2 shows neutral range consolidation, and while the MACD histogram is improving, the trend strength indicator ADX remains at 9.9, indicating a lack of trend. The volume ratio of 0.34 compared to the 5-day average suggests subdued trading volume, lowering confidence in directional judgment. Entry conditions are not met within the sideways range between the 100,000 support and 100,910 resistance levels.
